name: brynich_roundabout
_comment: A40 / A470 / B4601 Brynich roundabout, Brecon, Wales. Local metres, origin = ring centre, x east, y north. Centrelines from OpenStreetMap (see SOURCES.md), arms simplified to straight approaches aimed into the ring; flat (z = 0). The real arms are offset (tangential) and the A40 is a pair of one-way ways: here the A40 SW arm is one dual-carriageway road.
